scraping.title: HDFC Online Deposit Login
scraping.visible_text: Login With OTP Important note: · The deposits in the Bank are insured with DICGC for an amount of Rs.5 Lakhs (Principal + Interest) per depositor · In terms of Reserve Bank of India Directives, Interest will be calculated at quarterly intervals on Term Deposits and payable at the rate decided by the bank depending upon the period of deposits. In case of Monthly Deposit Scheme, the interest will be calculated for the quarter and paid monthly at discounted value. · HDFC Bank computes interest based on the actual number of days in a year. In case, the Deposit is spread over a leap and a non-leap year, the interest is calculated based on the number of days i.e., 366 days in a leap year & 365 days in a non leap year. · In the absence of any maturity instruction or in case of auto renewal the deposit will be renewed for a period equal to that of the original deposit at the prevailing rate on the date of renewal · Maturity amount for deposits would vary to the extent of tax and compounding effect on tax for the period subsequent of deduction till maturity and also due to rounding off (to the extent of 50 paise in each F.Y.) · Effective Deposit Date will be based on fund received in HDFC Bank account. · In case of premature closure of Fixed Deposit (including sweep in / partial closure) the interest rate will be 1.00% below of the lower of either – 1) the contracted rate or 2) the applicable rate for the period the deposit has remained with the bank, whichever is lower. · In Case of premature withdrawal of the fixed deposit based on depositor’s instructions or the instructions of all the joint depositors in the case of joint deposit, the bank has the right to recover interest already paid or the penalty, if any, from the proceeds of the fixed deposit in accordance with prevailing regulations of the bank and the Reserve Bank of India. · To know more about HDFC Bank products/ prevailing interest rates /any query/ suggestion/ feedback, please visit our branch, bank website www.hdfc.bank.in or you may write to support@hdfcbank.com. (1), (2) & (3) are remittances/forex drawls availed under LRS across all Authorised Dealers (ADs). Definition of Specified Person: "Specified Person" means a person who satisfies both the following conditions: He/She has not furnished the return of income for the assessment year relevant to the previous year immediately preceding the financial year in which tax is required to be deducted/collected. The previous year to be counted is required to be the one whose return filing date under sub-section (1) of section 139 has expired. The aggregate tax deducted at source and tax collected at source is Rupees Fifty thousand or more in that previous year. scraping.title: Welcome to NetSafe and Verified by Visa / MasterCard SecureCode / ProtectBuy
scraping.visible_text: Home Demo's Regenerate Card Register Now Reset your password FAQ's ProtectBuy Welcome to NetSafe and Verified by Visa(VBV)/MasterCard® SecureCode™(MSC)/ProtectBuySM Verified by Visa(VBV)/MasterCard® SecureCode™ (MSC)/ProtectBuySM is a service from Visa/MasterCard/Diners that lets you shop online securely with your existing Debit/Credit card on participating VBV/MSC/ProtectBuy websites. It protects you against unauthorized use of your card at participating online retailers by displaying a personal message known only to you and your bank. Your transaction would be complete only after you provide your VBV/MSC/ProtectBuy password. NetSafe is a unique online secure payment solution from HDFC Bank. NetSafe enables you to generate a unique virtual card number using your physical Visa Debit/Credit or Mastercard Debit/Credit Card. Your physical card number is thus safe from getting exposed on the net. NetSafe is currently FREE for all HDFC Bank Visa and Mastercard Debit and Credit Card holders. We have discontinued the Netsafe virtual card facility on HDFC Bank Debit Cards effective 25th July '24. We have discontinued the Netsafe virtual card facility on HDFC Bank Credit Card effective 6th Aug 25. We will discontinue the Netsafe Virtual card facility on HDFC Bank Corporate Credit Card effective 25 Nov 25. Note: 1. The login ID and password created by you during the registration process is valid for NetSafe and Verified by Visa / MasterCard® SecureCode™/ ProtectBuySM. 2. While transacting online on Verified by Visa/ MasterCard® SecureCode™/ ProtectBuySM enabled websites, there will be a password prompt. Please enter your password. The Login Id is not required for performing online transactions. 3. You can re-set your password online. Your Login Id is not required to re-set your password. 4. Register for ProtectBuy to avoid decline of internet transactions using your HDFC Bank Diners Credit Card. 5. Register for RuPay PaySecure to avoid decline of internet transactions using your HDFC Bank RuPay Debit Card. 6. Please ensure that your latest mobile number/ email id is updated in the Bank records. CitiFX Pulse puts the network, technology, infrastructure and trading powers of the world’s leading corporate and institutional bank behind you, giving you complete control over your FX management, allowing you to hedge your exposures in 80+ markets, straight from and to your treasury management system (TMS) or enterprise resource planning (ERP). Speak to your CitiFX salesperson to find out more. CitiFX Pulse enables services such as connectivity to your treasury or trading ecosystems, market information and research, an integrated exposure management tool, post trade settlement, reconciliation and analysis tools, and many more services. We provide real-time 24-hour access to FX Spot, Forward, NDF and Swaps pricing in 500+ currencies complete with pre-trade and post-trade workflow tools all delivered through a seamless intuitive user-experience in 80+ countries. Recommended system requirements to run CitiFX Pulse CPU Intel or AMD processor with 64-bit support; Recommended 2.8 GHz or higher RAM 8 GB of free disk space Operating System Windows 10, Mac OS 12 or higher Networking 100 Mbps or higher, Ethernet card connected to the Internet or a VPN Screen Resolution 1920x1080 or higher, 32-bit colour Web Browser Microsoft Edge v88, Firefox v80, Safari v14 and Google Chrome v80 onwards. This website supports IPv6. Pre-Trade Before trading, you need simple tools to load your orders into a trading platform as well as information about the markets. CitiFX Pulse allows you to easily upload FX requests directly from your treasury ecosystem (ERP, TMS or Position Management Software). Its rich workflows offer, depending on the markets you need to trade, the possibility to submit trades with settlement instructions, FX payments or regulatory documents. CitiFX Pulse has news, research and alerts on tap, connecting you with everything from the published content of our world-class research team to the market commentary of our expert sales and trading teams. Accessing information this way helps you assess and act on the impact of market events to your business, from trading floor to trading platform in real-time. Execution When the time comes, control, accuracy and speed to market are critical. Pulse brings it all together to help you execute with confidence, enriched with everything from live rates and price requests to multi-leg dealing, benchmark execution, options and more. CitiFX Pulse allows you to gain single centralized view to all markets, onshore and offshore, using a single User ID. Your central Treasury may execute transactions acting on behalf of the local entity and facing onshore branch. If an oversight-only function is preferred, your central Treasury may simply monitor executions done by the subsidiaries Pulse execution module is configured to specific requirements of each market. User profiles may be configured to facilitate controls needs and offers controls on Access Types (Maker/ Checker /Read Only) Dealing Entity, Currency Pair, Side, Tenor, Notional, Time of Day, and IP Address Post-trade After trading, you need to settle your trades, make and track payments, split, allocate transactions or attach additional documentation. Pulse Post Trade Module allows you to do that and access a rich suite of other post trade services. Knowing the effect of your FX trades is crucial to developing a full understanding of their impact on your cashflow, positions and exposure to risk. Pulse gives you access to real-time and historical data, with up to seven years of transaction history. Customizing the reports you generate and downloading them for later uploading onto your treasury management or other system means you can view and evaluate all deals executed with Citi, regardless of their original execution method. 500+ Currency Pairs 80 Global Treasury Sites 40+ Awards since 2015 Award Winning Platform 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 2018 2017 2016 2015 2014 2013 2012 2011 Global Finance Best Bank Digital Platform Push your FX experience to new heights CitiFX Pulse - Designed with you in mind REQUEST ACCESS TO CITIFX PULSE © 2026 Citigroup Inc. scraping.title: CSB KYC UPDATION
scraping.visible_text: Home FAQs Security Tips Contact Us KYC Updation CSB BANK KYC UPDATION Greetings, "Your security and convenience matter to us! To keep your account safe and ensure smooth services, please update your KYC details, Address and Demographic changes. It's quick, easy, and helps us serve you better. Click below to start your hassle-free update today." Login to the website with credentials to update. You can update your details easily through E-KYC using Aadhaar or by document submission. To complete your E-KYC, please review and edit the form with the details available with the Bank and authenticate using the OTP. Your information will be updated directly from the Aadhaar. Alternatively, you may update your details by uploading scanned copies of the required documents. Kindly keep any of the following documents ready for a smooth update process: Aadhaar Card Voters ID Driving License Passport NREGA Job Card National Population Register If your PAN has not been registered with the Bank, please update and submit a scanned copy of your PAN Card to update your records. Thank you for Banking with us. For any information: Please visit nearest branch OR contact us at our Toll free number: 1800 266 9090, +91-22-45393939 OR mail us at: customercare@csb.bank.in Update and confirm KYC details with CSB BANK Proceed

Resources Terms and Conditions Charges & Fees Privacy Policy Key Facts Statement Protect your financial identity At ADCB, we would never ask you for any personal information other than your User ID and Password when you log into ADCB Personal Internet Banking. To ensure that you do not fall victim of fraud, never respond to any e-mail from an address that appears to be from ADCB requesting personal information, account details or information on your Internet Banking User ID and Password. Report a suspicious e-mail Cyber Cafe Security About e-mail fraud To Login Please use the physical keyboard to key the User ID which is your 6 Or 8 digit CID number. Use the mouse to enter keys from the Virtual Keyboard for the Internet Banking Password. Why Virtual Keyboard Login? The Virtual Keyboard is dynamic. The sequence in which the keys appear will change every time the page is refreshed. The Virtual Keyboard protects you from malicious ’Spy Ware’ and ’Trojan Programs’ designed to capture your keystrokes. scraping.visible_text: × Important Information The Positive Pay System (PPS) is a tool designed to protect cheque transactions from probable fraud. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has announced the introduction of the Positive Pay System for the Cheque Truncation System (CTS). The concept of the Positive Pay System involves a process of reconfirming key details of large value cheques. Under this process, the issuer of the cheque shall submit, through channels like mobile banking app (ai1), internet banking, WhatsApp Banking, Branch Channel etc., certain details of that cheque such as Cheque Number, Cheque Date, Amount, Payee’s Name, and MICR Code. These details are cross-checked when the cheque is presented through CTS Clearing. Any mismatch in the details submitted by the customer and the cheque received in clearing shall make the cheque liable for dishonour. All our esteemed customers are requested to note that while issuing cheques for amounts of ₹5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs Only) and above, it is mandatory to register cheque details under the Positive Pay System. In case the cheque details are not submitted to PPS, such cheques shall be liable to be dishonoured and returned to the presenting banker. scraping.title: FedOne - Federal Bank Transaction Banking Platform
scraping.visible_text: Secure, safe and responsible usage guidelines Log on to the service by typing the URL in the address bar. Make sure that the page opening is from genuine service provider. While logging on to FedOne, always check the URL in the address bar of your internet browser. Be sure the URL you are accessing has https://. The letter s at the end of https means secured and the site uses encryption for enhanced safety. To login to FedOne, Federal Bank's internet banking site, please type www.federalbank.co.in in the address bar of the browser and then click the FedOne link provided at the home page. Never make use of links provided / stored anywhere else. Do not store passwords in a file on ANY electronic devices (including mobile/ desktop/ Laptop or similar devices) without encryption. Enter your user-id and password only in the space provided in the FedOne site login screen. If you notice any changes from the normal and feel that there is an attempt to steal your personal information, please drop a mail to contact@federalbank.co.in or call our Toll Free numbers 1800-420-1199 / 1800-425-1199 to report the same. Never share your passwords. Do not divulge your password to anyone including Bank officials. Look for the padlock icon appearing at the top or bottom of the browser and click on it to see the VeriSign certificate issued to the site, authenticating it as the official website of Federal Bank. Alternatively click on the VeriSign icon to see the certificate. Follow the precautions mentioned there in, while viewing. Federal Bank never sends e-mail and embedded links asking you to provide personal details such as your Account number, Debit Card number, ATM PIN or Online Banking passwords. If you receive such e-mails, never respond to them. Do not let your computer remember your password. Never accept auto complete option provided by your computer/ browser. Change passwords at least once every 60 (sixty) days. Do not provide user-id and password on any page that appears when you click on a hyperlink received through email. Never access the internet banking from an un-trusted system. Install the latest Antivirus software on your computer system. This will reduce the risk of virus attacks. Always update antivirus software periodically which will resist newer viruses. Install personal firewall on your computer system. This will provide additional level of security. Do NOT download from unfamiliar sources. It may contain hidden programs or viruses that can compromise your computer's security. Avoid accessing your Internet Banking account from a cyber cafe or a shared computer. However, if you happen to do so, change your password from your personal computer at the earliest. सुनिश्चित, सुरक्षित और उत्तरदायी उपयोग दिशानिर्देश एड्रेस बार में URL टाइप करके सर्विस में लॉग ऑन करें। सुनिश्चित करें कि खुलने वाला पेज वास्तविक सेवा प्रदाता का है। जब आप FedOne में लॉग इन कर रहे हों, तो एड्रेस बार में दिए गए URL एड्रेस को हमेशा चेक करें। आपके इंटरनेट ब्राउज़र के एड्रेस बार पर URL एड्रेस https से शुरू होता है; https के अंत में 's' अक्षर का अर्थ है 'सुरक्षित'। सुनिश्चित करें कि आप जिस URL को एक्सेस कर रहे हैं, उसमें 'https://' है। 's' दर्शाता है कि साइट सुरक्षित है और एन्क्रिप्शन का उपयोग करती है। फेडरल बैंक की इंटरनेट बैंकिंग साइट FedOne में लॉग इन करने के लिए, कृपया ब्राउज़र के एड्रेस बार में www.federalbank.co.in टाइप करें और फिर होम पेज पर दिए गए FedOne लिंक पर
